summary: Simone Brunozzi, Italian, living in San Francisco, Technology Evangelist at Amazon Web Services, former employee at AWS for over 6 years, strong interest in cloud computing and technology, experienced public speaker with over 500 talks, advocate for effective teaching methods, passionate about beekeeping, strong opinions on social issues, critical of corporate practices, engaged in discussions about transportation and urban planning, has a father-son relationship with his dad, frequent traveler with extensive flight experience, active in online communities related to technology and startups, has lived in Singapore for 2.5 years, interested in cultural exchange and understanding, critical of food quality in San Francisco compared to Italy, has a background in computer science, and has a strong interest in the intersection of technology and social impact.
